# Gloda custom query helpers receive positional values after the attribute definition

The facet uses apply(query, groupValues), and the registered helper wrapper calls the noun helper with aAttrDef followed by spread arguments. Account and Category must therefore collect trailing positional values with a rest parameter to iterate them as an array. Category consumes MIME objects and their category fields, while Account follows each folder object's account root. This is the actual custom Gloda call contract; no general method-name or loop rule follows from it.

Scope: Gloda query helper registration and MIME/folder noun helpers.
